proposed_instruction: When marking a MEDDICC component as Unknown or Partial in the first call, ensure next steps ask multiple clarifying questions to build a complete picture. For Economic Buyer specifically, always ask: (1) who has budget authority, (2) who influences the decision, (3) are there approval workflows or gatekeepers, and (4) should they be involved in the trial. Generic 'who approves this' questions may miss stakeholders with veto power or budget control.
